suspects.description: Pointer-array store through a raw address constant (lost symbolic global; §11/§15) — use the symbolic global indexed by element

Pointer value `local_18` truncated by cast to `int` (sub-pointer width) — correct on the 32-bit matching build, a hard `cast from pointer to smaller type` error at 64-bit. If the value is used as an integer (delta, address print, hash), rewrite the cast as `uintptr_t`/`intptr_t` in a .keep.

Raw hex address 0x54ca26 assigned to bare local `uVar20`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `uVar20` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.

Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `pCVar12` self-updates via pointer arithmetic on an inner array field reached through a chained field path; the array decays to a pointer and `+ CONST` adds `CONST * sizeof(element)` bytes, matching the outer array stride. Replace `pCVar12->some_field[0]` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update.
